directive.quote: finish the film repository port so the repo can be retired: settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door

preserve: the stores are read as q.py read them: the asset index's matrices and ids, the timed frames cut to the shorter of the two files, the results store's picture-vectors frames of the right size with their path and time, and the namespace store's live aliases as each video's b2 id; every source opened read-only

Keep the float32 values the source computed: normalize asset matrices and decoded app-result frames once in float32, and preserve the timed frame values after the source float32 conversion. Writing the set must not normalize again or reduce values to float16, because that can reverse close hit order.
allowed_deltas: the stores are arguments (--asset-index, --ssd-index, --expansion-results, --namespace, --kind) instead of what the place reports in its environment
each store is written as a vector set (items.jsonl, vectors.npy, vector-set.json) instead of being searched here; the search is findSimilarAcross
the readable names of the asset index are read for every item, not only for the hits

vector-set.json carries search_mode exact as a descriptor field, because q.py scored all source vectors before the spread/top limit; callers keep this alongside vector_set. No ANN parameter is changed to approximate the source job.

Relocate the existing reader into the common account-wide search owner; retain the prior-owner baseline as history and capture the identical original bytes at the receiving target before the active adaptation. Update only owner-relative imports, supplied paths and current consumer references.
banned_substitutions: a person's index folders, drives or film folders written into the code
A lower-precision vector cast or extra normalization that changes the source-compute values
_private_repository: Opaque source alias containing the BLAKE3 identity of the repository label. Resolve this alias through the existing explicit repositories map; pinned source commit, path/content identities and retirement checks remain unchanged. No private source location is published.
